title: Sign in to the Altium portal with a session ID
summary: Signs Altium Designer in to the Altium portal with a session ID obtained outside AD (IDXPAltiumPortal.LoginBySessionID) and reports the sign-in state (LoggedIn, LoggingIn, IsBusy, user name).
phrasings: log in to Altium 365 from an extension
check whether the user is signed in
use a browser session to sign in Altium Designer
read the signed-in user name of the portal

commands.name: Login
commands.description: Sign in to the Altium portal with a session ID
commands.params: SessionId=<session ID; optional from the menu, which then asks for it in a dialog>

commands.name: LoginState
commands.description: Show the Altium portal sign-in state
